title: 第183章 16头猎人同时发动扑击！（加更！）
slug: 班级求生我是大客车内唯一男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

行驶在公路上的小货车焕然一新。

车身上的血迹和抓痕都不见了。

就连破损的车窗也焕然一新。

李沐晴已经用求生币修复了小货车两次。

他们手里的求生币已经用了10枚，只剩下13枚了。

还有两次维修小货车的机会，如果都用完了，还没到终点的话，他们就只能下车跑向终点了。

这么多C级猎人追着，没了载具的结果可想而知。

顾屿死死抓着方向盘，一头头C级猎人嘶吼着扑过来。

他从后视镜看到，黑色小轿车死死咬在车后，明摆着要利用小货车抵挡着前方扑过来的猎人丧尸。

顾屿也没啥办法，总不能刹车减速吧？

李沐晴脸色越来越白，她座椅上浸满了血液。

虽然大部分玻璃渣子被她随手用窗帘扫了下去，还是有少部分玻璃嵌在椅子里，只能用指甲一颗颗夹出。

但她没有这个时间的，因为16头C级的猎人汇聚在一起，不断从四面八方发动攻击。

小货车即将汇入一个U型弯。

顾屿已经能很熟练地操控小货车过弯了。

就在小货车来到U型弯的中段，刚准备出弯时。

李沐晴的耳朵突然动了动，她似乎听到了更多的嘶吼声。

好像来自弯道的拐角处。

因为李沐晴血越流越多，顾屿此时撞红了眼，他眼球布满血丝，恨不得直接操控着小货车飞向终点。

李沐晴忽然大喊：

“屿哥！出弯后小心！可能会有更多的...”

她话还没说完，小货车刚拐出弯道后，便看到，直路一条的公路上，有十来头猎人正飞速冲过来！

顾屿和李沐晴看到这一幕，直接瞪大了眼睛。

之前都只是零星几头扑过来的猎人，顾屿还能靠着技术躲过去，或者直接碾过去。

可现在，16头猎人直接在路中央堵着，这怎么过？

李沐晴抓紧手里的5枚求生币，赶紧给屿哥汇报耐久度：

“我们还有94耐久！”

顾屿听到后，直接将油门踩死，并朝李沐晴大喊：

“沐晴！护着头抓紧了！”

李沐晴一听，虽然很担心双手开车的屿哥怎么护着头，但她本能地选择相信屿哥的话。

李沐晴直接左手护头，右手抓紧头顶的把手。

顾屿觉得还不够保险，他直接抓起用来遮挡的窗帘，罩在了李沐晴身上。

待会的挡风玻璃可能会破裂，他想避免玻璃渣子划伤沐晴。

顾屿还嫌不够。

他左手抓着方向盘，右手伸向李沐晴脑袋前，张开五指，掌心朝外地保护着李沐晴的头。

虽然车辆的挡风玻璃碎裂后，不会有大面积的玻璃碎飞出，但为了安全，顾屿不敢赌。

他宁愿自己多受点伤，也不想沐晴受哪怕一丁点伤害！

他的女人！他必须全力护着！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The pickup truck on the road has a new look.

The blood stains and scratches on the car were gone.

Even the broken car windows looked brand new.

Li Muqing has used survival coins to repair the pickup truck twice.

They have used 10 of the survival coins in their hands and only have 13 left.

There are still two opportunities to repair the minivan. If they are used up and they have not reached the finish line, they will have to get out and run to the finish line.

With so many C-level hunters chasing after them, one can imagine the consequences of losing the vehicle.

Gu Yu clutched the steering wheel tightly, and C-level hunters roared and rushed towards him.

He saw in the rearview mirror that the black car was clinging to the back of the car, clearly intending to use the small truck to fend off the hunter zombies coming from the front.

Gu Yu had nothing to do. He couldn't brake and slow down, right?

Li Muqing's face turned paler and paler, and her seat was soaked in blood.

Although most of the glass shards were swept away by her with the curtains, a small amount of glass was still embedded in the chair and could only be pinched out one by one with her fingernails.

But she didn't have this time, because 16 C-level hunters gathered together and continued to attack from all directions.

The pickup truck is about to merge into a U-shaped bend.

Gu Yu was already able to control the minivan through corners very skillfully.

Just as the pickup truck reached the middle of the U-shaped bend, it was just about to exit the bend.

Li Muqing's ears suddenly moved, and she seemed to hear more roars.

As if coming from the corner of a curve.

Because Li Muqing was bleeding more and more, Gu Yu's eyes were red and bloodshot, and he wished he could directly control the small truck to fly to the finish line.

Li Muqing suddenly shouted:

"Brother Yu! Be careful after exiting the bend! There may be more..."

Before she could finish her words, as soon as the pickup truck turned out of the corner, she saw a dozen hunters rushing over on a straight road!

When Gu Yu and Li Muqing saw this scene, their eyes widened.

In the past, there were just a few hunters that rushed towards them, but Gu Yu could still rely on his skills to avoid them or simply run over them.

But now, 16 hunters are blocked directly in the middle of the road. How can we survive?

Li Muqing grabbed the five survival coins in her hand and quickly reported the durability to Brother Yu:

"We still have 94 durability!"

After Gu Yu heard this, he stepped on the accelerator and shouted to Li Muqing:

"Mu Qing! Protect your head and hold on tight!"

When Li Muqing heard this, she was worried about how Brother Yu, who was driving with both hands, could protect his head, but she instinctively chose to believe what Brother Yu said.

Li Muqing directly protected her head with her left hand and grasped the handle above her head with her right hand.

Gu Yu felt that it was not safe enough, so he directly grabbed the curtain and covered Li Muqing.

The windshield might break later, and he wanted to avoid glass shards from scratching Mu Qing.

Gu Yu didn't think it was enough.

He grabbed the steering wheel with his left hand, stretched his right hand in front of Li Muqing's head, spread his fingers, and protected Li Muqing's head with his palm facing outward.

Although a large area of ​​broken glass would not fly out after the vehicle's windshield was broken, Gu Yu did not dare to gamble for the sake of safety.

He would rather he get hurt a little more than Mu Qing get hurt even a little bit!

His woman!He must protect him with all his strength!
